subject: general
question: The classical singer, Girija Devi was proficient in which form of Hindustani classical music?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Thumri**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Girija Devi** is a classical singer and represents **Banaras Gharana**.

 
 
• She was born on **8 May 1929**, in **Varanasi, Uttar Pradesh.**
 
• She is also called **Queen of Thumri**.
 
• She has won **Padma Shree (1972), Padma Bhushan (1989), **and **Padma Vibhushan (2016)** for her contribution to classical music.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4da3aa2769c5263f2bf0682498f8548422fa9d599e32ff93dcdd253fcc59d464.png] 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• Hindustani Classical Music is a part of** Indian classical music** practised in **north India**.

 
 
• The Hindustani branch adopted a scale of** Shudha Swara Saptaka** or the **Octave of Natural notes**.
 
• **Tabla, Sarangi, Sitar, Santoor, Flute, and violin** are its instruments.
 
• **Chaturanga, Ragasagar, Tarana,Sargam,Dhrupad, Dhamar, Hori, Khayal,Tappa and Thumri** are its main singing style.​
